verdict.rationale: The Emerging Companies & Growth page explicitly documents full lifecycle coverage from formation through exit, stating the firm draws on its strength as the world's leading capital markets and M&A firm to position clients for optimal liquidity events, citing IPOs, direct listings, and deSPACs, alongside seed/venture financing support and global venture-hub presence — directly matching the founder's exit-through-M&A/public-offering story. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration (league tables, deal case studies) beyond the firm's own practice page, and more granular public-offering process detail.
